notes_for_editor: Dates agree across firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts (1918 crow's nest, 1928 cabin with pole tower, 1955 destroyed). Staff names come from a book by Bert Russell (Hardship & Happy Times) that I did not see; only Dennis has a year (1919), and the other two are shown with unknown years. The Shoshone County Forest Lookouts page has an empty Stubtoe entry, so it is not cited. No description of the site today was found. Record county Shoshone matches the firelookout.org list; the Idaho site names the St. Joe National Forest. Record access 'unknown' could be updated to the Idaho site's 'Drive-Up' label, which is in visit. Search budget: 2 searches.
